title: Firecrawl Web Search
overviewMarkdown:
Search the web via [Firecrawl](https://firecrawl.dev) and return cleaned markdown of top results.

## Setup

1. Get an API key from [firecrawl.dev](https://firecrawl.dev) (cloud) **or** run your own [self-hosted Firecrawl](https://github.com/firecrawl/firecrawl).
2. In this plugin's settings:
   - **Base URL**: `https://api.firecrawl.dev` (cloud, default) or your self-hosted URL like `https://firecrawl.example.com`.
   - **API Key**: your `fc-...` key from the cloud, or whatever Bearer token your self-hosted gateway expects.
3. Enable the plugin in your chat session.

Works alongside `Firecrawl Scrape URL` for fetching specific pages.

openaiSpec.name: firecrawl_web_search
openaiSpec.description: Search the web for the given query and return cleaned markdown of the top results. Use this for any current-information question — news, prices, product comparisons, recent releases, anything that may have changed after your training data.

query.description: The search query in the user's language. Be specific.

limit.description: Number of results to fetch with content. Default 5, max 10.

userSettings.name: baseUrl
userSettings.label: Firecrawl Base URL
userSettings.description: `https://api.firecrawl.dev` for the cloud, or your own self-hosted URL.

userSettings.name: apiKey
userSettings.label: Firecrawl API Key (Bearer)
userSettings.description: Your `fc-...` cloud API key, or the Bearer token your self-hosted gateway expects.

userSettings.name: onlyMainContent
userSettings.label: Only main content (strip nav/footer/ads)
userSettings.description: Recommended: keep as true so the LLM gets the article body, not boilerplate.

userSettings.name: maxCharsPerResult
userSettings.label: Max characters per result
userSettings.description: Trim each result's markdown to this length to control token usage.
